The Workhorse 8" for Pro Audio Applications.Engineered for versatility, the FS8.20A8 delivers tight, impactful low-frequencyperformance with smooth upper-mid response-perfect for portable PA, point-source designs, and 2-way cabinets. Its efficient ferrite motor structure offersexcellent transient response and high power handling, giving designers adependable, full-range foundation for countless system configurations.Built to handle real-world demands, this 8" model offers a robust balance of output, clarity, and durability.
